name: Industrial Chemistry
tagline: Scale-up, process chemistry, and manufacturing of chemical products.
seo_title: Industrial Chemistry — paper summaries, news & innovations | Chemisters
seo_description: Follow Chemisters Industrial Chemistry on LinkedIn and Facebook: paper summaries, news and innovations in chemical manufacturing, bulk chemicals, fertilizers, plastics and process decarbonization.

definition.lead: Industrial chemistry turns chemical reactions into products at scale, safely and economically: fertilizers, fuels, plastics, metals and medicines.
definition.body: It is where laboratory discoveries meet reactors, supply chains, energy costs and regulation. A handful of large processes, making ammonia, sulfuric acid, ethylene and chlorine, underpin much of the material economy.

timeline.title: The lead-chamber process
timeline.text: John Roebuck makes sulfuric acid in lead-lined chambers.
timeline.why: Made sulfuric acid cheap enough for industry.

timeline.title: The Leblanc process
timeline.text: Nicolas Leblanc patents a method to make soda ash from salt.

timeline.title: The Contact process
timeline.text: Peregrine Phillips patents oxidizing SO₂ over a platinum catalyst.
timeline.why: Later became the standard route to sulfuric acid.

timeline.title: Synthetic dyes
timeline.text: Perkin's mauveine starts the synthetic dye industry.
timeline.why: Gave rise to companies like BASF, Bayer and Hoechst.

timeline.title: The Solvay process
timeline.text: Ernest Solvay opens his first plant making soda ash from salt, limestone and ammonia.

timeline.title: Bakelite
timeline.text: Leo Baekeland makes the first fully synthetic plastic.

timeline.title: Industrial ammonia
timeline.text: BASF opens the first Haber–Bosch plant at Oppau.
timeline.why: Nitrogen fertilizer on an industrial scale.

timeline.title: Nylon
timeline.text: Wallace Carothers's team at DuPont makes nylon.
timeline.why: The first commercially successful fully synthetic fibre.

timeline.title: Bhopal
timeline.text: A toxic gas leak at a pesticide plant in Bhopal, India, kills thousands of people.
timeline.why: Transformed process safety and chemical regulation worldwide.

timeline.title: Responsible Care
timeline.text: The chemical industry launches the Responsible Care initiative in Canada.
timeline.why: A voluntary commitment to safety and environmental performance.
